name: Paper trading of crypto portfolio v9.8: v9.7 with the listing short replaced by the Gen468 event short (flagged post hoc; ACCEPTED by the user 2026-10-27)
registered: 2026-10-27; accepted by the user; replaces v96 (which ran about 1 day and still holds the dropped cascade). Starts on the user's PC, re-using v96's downloaded market data
what: Hourly forward test of v8 = v7 (v6 + Gen108/109 ridge ML) + the Gen247 altcoin kimchi sleeve (16 altcoins: Upbit KRW / USD-KRW / Binance perp premium z > 1 long 0.1, < -1 short 0.1, held next day, 5 bp + funding). The ridge ML sleeve is (BTC/ETH perps: ridge regression on 17 daily features, refit monthly on all earlier data, prediction / training sd clipped to +-1, position 0.5 x prediction, decided at the 00:00 UTC close, 5 bp taker + funding). Same construction as v6: point-in-time equal risk (Weiss half weight), 30-day vol targeting. Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 50% of the firm's 5% daily loss limit (2.5%), exit 10 bp worse (Gen230 setting)
frozen.costs: as in research: C* 7.5 bp, premium carry / trend / Weiss 5 bp taker, cascade 2 bp maker entry + 5 bp exit, real funding; deleveraging bounce and ridge ML 5 bp taker + funding
frozen.booking: cascade entry fee in the fill hour and Weiss legs as each bar closes (live=True); same totals as research
frozen.risk_note: Gen323 supersedes Gen318: HyroTrader caps funded open notional at 2x the initial balance; challenge risk 2.0 (no cap in the evaluation), FUNDED risk 1.5 with an exposure cap of 1.9x and a $1,000 no-trade band (research/FIRM_RULES_EXECUTION.md). The paper ledger runs at the challenge risk 2.0.
frozen.ridge_inputs: Binance 5m/funding/premium/open interest (as v6), Coinbase BTC/ETH hourly, Upbit KRW hourly + Yahoo USD/KRW (kimchi, Gen105 strict London dating, previous day's FX), Deribit DVOL daily, Coin Metrics USDT+USDC caps (2-day lag); scripts/ridge_live.py, live feeds src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py; v8 adds Upbit KRW hourly for 16 altcoins (src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py, alts=True); v8.4 adds Binance spot BTC/ETH hourly with taker-buy volume (src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py spot) and the DVOL level
frozen.extra_data: as v9.0 + Binance long/short ratios (6 coins, live endpoint, last 30 days), Coinbase USDT-USD hourly, DefiLlama stablecoin supply, Blockchain.com fees, Deribit option trades (hourly features) + v9.6: USDT-M perps listed in the last 45 days (Binance exchangeInfo onboardDate, hourly klines, funding; qpl.live.binance_public.update_listings) + v9.8: 5-minute long/short ratios of perps listed in the last 3 days (<data>/listings/<SYM>_ratios.parquet), Binance delisting announcements (www.binance.com public CMS list, catalog 161; qpl.live.binance_announcements) and hourly klines + funding of each announced coin's perp (qpl.live.binance_public.update_event_coins)
frozen.listing_note: History before the paper start comes from research_data/binance_pit (symbols A..S until the rest is downloaded); live listings come from the exchange. The live bot trades the listing short only where the coin is listed on the firm's exchange (Bybit) and within the firm's low-cap cap (HyroTrader: 5% of the initial balance incl. leverage; v9.6 max about 4.2% at risk 1.5).
frozen.event_note: scripts/event_live.py: listing short sized x clip(L / 1.5, 0.5, 2) by the all-account long/short ratio in the 24 h before entry (history: config/listing_crowding.json) + spot-delisting shorts 0.05 for 14 days, 30% stop; gross cap 0.5. The live bot trades a delisting short only if the coin's perp is on the firm's exchange. Gen472 (accepted 2026-10-27): only coins with a Bybit USDT perp launched before that hour count, before the gross cap (research_data/bybit_listings/instruments.json + <data>/bybit_instruments.json, refreshed from the user's PC).
frozen.v98_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol 2022-26 of the v9.8 paper code (with the Gen472 Bybit filter) on the research pack: 3.24 / 3.063 / 3.91 / 2.67

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = v9.7 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
gate.clean_period_rule: v9.8.1: only paper hours after the relative-crowding fix count toward the 56-day validation (see changes 2026-11-02); the earlier hours are reported separately as 'affected (pre-fix)'

relative crowding 6 data / timing fix. (1) scripts/basket_live.py: the daily position calendar now reaches the day of the hour being positioned (_days_for). Before, DAYS ended at the day of END (= last completed hour), so the 00:00 UTC book of each new day set the daily and 3-day versions (4 of 6) to 0 for that hour and re-opened them at 01:00: a daily round trip (~$190k notional a day at $200k / risk 2.0, ~0.057% of equity a day in costs) that the frozen ledger did not show (it is computed an hour later with the full calendar). (2) src/qpl/live/binance_public.py: update_ratios drops duplicate timestamps per endpoint (Binance repeats bars across pages; the column merge raised 'cannot reindex on an axis with duplicate labels' on every run since 2026-10-27, so the live long/short ratios were never updated and the daily signal ran on stale values carried forward from the research pack's last day); ratio_status() added. (3) scripts/paper_v5.py: logs RC_DATA (newest ratio timestamp per coin) and DATA_STALE (> 2 h old or missing) every run. Monitoring only.
